title: Design System: The Exposed Question Binding

body.purpose: Controls, labels, supporting copy, and operational information.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Subtle press feedback and restrained state movement.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Button and answer-option color and border changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confident forest-green action with direct press and focus feedback.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; background: #284b39; padding: 0 18px; color: #fffefa; font: 700 1rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #1d392b; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #284b39; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.56; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet outlined action for secondary choices.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid #8d8677; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; padding: 0 18px; color: #292a25; font: 700 1rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #284b39; background: #f7f6f0; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #284b39; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Paper-colored field with a clear, high-contrast boundary.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Session code<input class="ds-field" placeholder="Six character code" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 9px; color: #292a25; font: 650 0.9rem/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height: 50px; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid #8d8677; border-radius: 2px; background: #fffefa; padding: 12px 14px; color: #292a25; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #284b39; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #65675e; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: A stable wordmark-and-link header separated by a fine linen rule.
components.html: LGLiterature GiantHost sign in
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 68px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9c1ad; color: #292a25; font: 700 0.95rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #76573b; color: #284b39; font: 500 0.75rem Literata, Georgia, serif; } .ds-nav-link { color: #284b39; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #284b39; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Question Thread
components.description: A fifteen-step progress path showing the shared run and its current state.
components.css: .ds-thread { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 0; border-left: 1px solid #c9c1ad; padding: 0 0 0 18px; list-style: none; color: #65675e; font: 400 0.75rem/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-thread li { position: relative; } .ds-thread li::before { position: absolute; top: 0.38em; left: -23px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 1px solid #76573b; border-radius: 50%; background: #fffefa; content: ''; } .ds-thread .is-complete, .ds-thread .is-current { color: #284b39; font-weight: 700; } .ds-thread .is-complete::before, .ds-thread .is-current::before { border-color: #284b39; background: #284b39; }

narrative.overview:
The interface feels like an open book that a host and guests move through together. Near-white paper, dark ink, and a fine linen-colored rule give the pages their quiet structure; a stitched fifteen-question path makes the shared run visible without turning it into broadcast spectacle. The atmosphere is editorial and warm, but the controls remain plain, familiar, and task-first.

Literata gives headings a bookish voice; Inter keeps forms, status, and reading clear. Flat surfaces and fine rules carry the layout instead of shadows or ornamental panels. The green marks the action and current state, while board brown and linen thread quietly recall the binding.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-and-ink surfaces with restrained forest-green actions and book-board details.
Editorial display type paired with practical sans-serif controls.
One visible stitched thread connecting the shared fifteen-question run.
Calm, accessible controls and explicit operational states.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Use green to identify an action or live state, not as a general decorative fill.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep Literata for editorial headings; use Inter for all information that must be scanned, entered, or acted on.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Separate content with whitespace and rules; do not lift ordinary sections into floating cards.

dos: Do use paper, ink, linen rules, and green states consistently across light and dark themes.
Do make the current question, answer choices, and host session state the easiest information to scan.
Do keep focus visible and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do use the stitched thread to express the shared fifteen-question sequence.
donts: Don't use shadows or floating dashboard cards to create hierarchy.
Don't turn the book-binding direction into ornamental game-show props or broadcast spectacle.
Don't use green as a large decorative surface when it is not marking an action or state.
Don't obscure status, answer privacy, or simulated prize information with visual treatment.
